entities.name: Phenolic substrate
observations: Decoded structure: 2-chloro-6-bromo-4-(4-ethoxybenzyl)phenol; contains phenolic OH and aryl Br/Cl substituents.

entities.name: Allyl bromide
observations: Serves as the allylating reagent in the matched reaction record.

entities.name: O-allyl ether product
observations: Likely product is the phenolic O-allyl ether; the aryl bromide and chloride remain unchanged.
Matched ORD reaction record reports 95% yield in acetone at 65 °C, with potassium carbonate as base.
